method: Visual inspection of both original 1280x720 screenshots per phase; Minecraft viewport 854x480, GUI scale 2, third-person view.

accepted.seed/third-person-dev.png: Styled spines visible; double spine distinguishable on middle track. Original rail/tie/control components and occupied car remain visible.
accepted.seed/third-person-observer.png: Styled spines visible; double spine distinguishable on middle track. Original rail/tie/control components and occupied car remain visible.
accepted.removed/third-person-dev.png: All tracks use original spine; middle track no longer has imported double spine. Riders remain seated.
accepted.removed/third-person-observer.png: All tracks use original spine; middle track no longer has imported double spine. Riders remain seated.
accepted.reinstalled/third-person-dev.png: Saved single/double spines visible again; middle double spine restored.
accepted.reinstalled/third-person-observer.png: Saved single/double spines visible again; middle double spine restored.
accepted.reinstalled/unloaded-dev.png: Player visible standing on smooth-stone platform after normal dismount.
accepted.reinstalled/unloaded-observer.png: Player visible standing on smooth-stone platform after normal dismount.

excluded.seed/styled-overview-dev.png: Captured before teleport settled; shows spawn ground.
excluded.seed/styled-overview-observer.png: Captured before teleport settled; not appearance evidence.
excluded.reinstalled/early-observation.json: Three-pig report before client join; not occupied human restoration proof.
excluded.reinstalled/occupied-final.json: Stale repeated-label read of early report. Superseded by unique occupied-verified report after fixing reader offset.

limits: Visual review is not pixel-perfect equivalence.
Model availability logging alone does not establish rendered output.
No shader/Flywheel backend matrix or moving inversion claim.
